description: Cys3 site co-conservation summary and search for a fourth metal ligand near the Cys3 centroid in the BchJ AlphaFold model
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
seq=open("out/bchj_P26169.fasta").read().split("\n")[1]
df=pd.read_csv("out/homolog_site_residues.csv")
df['nCys']=(df.C159=='C').astype(int)+(df.C185=='C').astype(int)+(df.C193=='C').astype(int)
df['isBchJlike']=df.name.fillna('').str.contains('vinyl|BchJ', case=False)
n30=(df.seqid>=30).sum(); f30=(df[df.seqid>=30].nCys==3).mean()
n20=(df.seqid<20).sum(); f20=(df[df.seqid<20].nCys==3).mean()
print("close orthologs seqid>=30%%: n=%d, Cys3-complete fraction=%.3f" % (n30, f30))
print("distant hits seqid<20%%:    n=%d, Cys3-complete fraction=%.3f" % (n20, f20))
print("\nProtein-name breakdown of V4R hits (top 12):")
print(df.name.fillna('NA').str.slice(0,52).value_counts().head(12).to_string())

at=defaultdict(dict)
for l in open("out/AF-P26169-F1.pdb"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM"): at[int(l[22:26])][l[12:16].strip()]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
cen=np.mean([at[159]['SG'],at[185]['SG'],at[193]['SG']],axis=0)
print("\nDistance of each Cys SG to the Cys3 centroid:")
for c in (159,185,193): print("   C%d SG  %.2f A" % (c, np.linalg.norm(at[c]['SG']-cen)))
print("\nNon-backbone atoms within 7 A of the Cys3 centroid:")
cand=[]
for resi,ats in at.items():
    for nm,xyz in ats.items():
        if nm in ('N','C','O','CA','CB'): continue
        d=float(np.linalg.norm(xyz-cen))
        if d<7: cand.append((round(d,2), seq[resi-1]+str(resi), nm))
for d,r,n in sorted(cand)[:20]: print("   %5.2f A  %-6s %s" % (d,r,n))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.2))
vc=df.nCys.value_counts().sort_index()
ax[0].bar(vc.index, vc.values, color=["#bab0ac","#bab0ac","#bab0ac","#e45756"])
for x,y in zip(vc.index, vc.values): ax[0].text(x,y+8,str(y),ha='center')
ax[0].set_xlabel("number of C159 / C185 / C193 retained")
ax[0].set_ylabel("homologs (n=%d)" % len(df))
ax[0].set_title("BchJ Cys3 site is kept or lost as a unit")
ax[1].boxplot([df[df.nCys==3].seqid, df[df.nCys<3].seqid], tick_labels=["all 3 Cys\n(n=%d)"%(df.nCys==3).sum(), "<3 Cys\n(n=%d)"%(df.nCys<3).sum()])
ax[1].set_ylabel("sequence identity to BchJ (%)")
ax[1].set_title("Cys3-complete homologs are the close BchJ orthologs")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
